speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis; which specific medication were you taking? Also, is the flank pain localized to one side, and have you noticed any changes in your urination?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you specifically take ciprofloxacin or another fluoroquinolone for your sinusitis? Have you noticed any pain or burning when you urinate, or any blood in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.
